<span id="joining"></span>
== Joining ==

There is no application. You do not need permission, a badge or a manager.

# Join [https://discord.gg/jZYA3r27tG Discord] and the [https://github.com/occupysaas GitHub organization].
# Read [[Rules of the road]]. If you have confidential knowledge from a former employer, say so before choosing a project.
# Follow [[Welcome and onboarding]].

<span id="leaving"></span>
== Leaving ==

Leave whenever you like. Your contributions stay under the project’s Apache-2.0 licence.
